findings.title: Resolve the printed enclosure in the 日 entry on 字源 PDF page 612
findings.details: In the quoted 說文 passage on PDF p. 612 / printed p. 599, the enclosure after 从 appears 口-shaped, while consulted transcriptions read 囗. Scan inspection did not settle its identity. Preserve this occurrence unresolved; do not normalize it to either graph without clearer source evidence.
findings.verification: Inspect a higher-resolution source scan or another reliable copy of the same edition. Record the exact occurrence and source evidence; apply a source-bound OCR correction only if the printed graph is clear.
